matchup.plan_title: Update (20:35 UTC 19 Nov): Kel'el Ware instead of Jones Jr. on 19 Nov
matchup.plan_md:
**Turner is out 19 Nov vs POR** with a left shoulder contusion. Ware's and Jericho Sims's minutes should rise ([NBC Sports, 19 Nov](https://www.nbcsports.com/fantasy/basketball/player-news/2026-11-19/myles-turner-shoulder-out-thursday-vs-portland)); *ESPN est.* 21 Nov.

**Why Ware wins step 1:**
- When Turner rested on 11 Nov, Ware started: 31 FP in 23 min.
- His last three were 30, 33 and 26 FP in 17–25 min.
- His rate (25.0) is built on bench minutes and sits under Jones Jr.'s 26.0, but extra minutes should put him in the 30s.
- Jones Jr.'s last six were 39, 16, 26, 43, 25 and 8 FP.

**Step 1 becomes:** drop Bamba, add **Kel'el Ware** (MIL vs POR) before 12:00 PM Fri 20 Melbourne. Steps 2–5 are unchanged, starting with dropping Ware after the game.

| Player | Rate | Season | L7 | L15 | L30 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Kel'el Ware | 25.0 | 23.3 (15) | 29.7 (3) | 19.5 (8) | 23.3 (15) |
| Derrick Jones Jr. | 26.0 | 27.0 (12) | 25.3 (3) | 26.2 (6) | 27.0 (12) |

Ware's L7 is +6.4, on 19.7 min against 18.1.
